The correction keeps that source binding, calls the existing make_confused implementation from the later Mb_hit branch, and supplies canspotmon to the pronoun helper used by muse.c:mloot_container. The full admitted replay now matches 331 screens, 3538 RNG calls, 331 cursors, and 126 animation frames with no error.
